title: ML↔FE-001: ML Output Schema & Semantics + Confidence/Drift Visualization Feedback
description: The Edge AI/ML Engineer provides the schema for confidence scores (value range, calibration metadata, per-class probabilities), drift signals (drift-metric values, threshold-breached indicators, drift-severity classification), and inference metadata (model version, inference timestamp, input context window), plus guidance on visual alerting thresholds (confidence floors, drift-severity-to-alert-urgency mapping) and documentation of model-output semantics for operator-facing presentation; the Frontend/Dashboard Engineer provides feedback on the interpretability of model outputs, UI requirements for confidence/drift display formats (visualization type, color-coding, update frequency, accessibility), and frontend alerting-threshold feedback. Grounded in EDGE_AI_ML_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.10 and FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.4. Drift-severity surfacing is the operator-facing edge of erosion-shaped detection (FC-022).

ml_output_schema.description: ML→FE: confidence/drift/inference schema + visual threshold guidance + output semantics.

confidence_floor.description: Recommended actionable-alert confidence floor (within the stated value_range).

frontend_visualization_feedback.description: FE→ML: interpretability feedback, UI display requirements, alerting-threshold feedback.

alerting_threshold_feedback.description: Whether current visual thresholds yield appropriate operator behaviour (not too many false alarms, not too few genuine alerts).

x-macp.tier_rationale: Defining the ML output schema and its operator-facing presentation is agent-autonomous sprint/planning coordination (output-schema alignment at planning; review when output formats change, with ≥2 weeks' notice before production). A change to the inference-output contract surface is versioned; the drift-severity surfacing ties to FC-022.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (planning-stage alignment on model output schema; review checkpoints when output formats change — ML notifies FE ≥2 weeks before the change reaches production; post-release operator-feedback review)
confirm_conditions: the confidence value range and every drift-metric value carry explicit units
drift severity classification and threshold-breached indicators are provided
inference metadata (model version, timestamp) accompanies the outputs
visual threshold guidance (confidence floor, severity-to-urgency mapping) is documented for alerting
reject_conditions: a confidence range or drift-metric value emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a model-output format change pushed to production without the ≥2-week notice to Frontend (contract-surface change)
a drift severity softened below its computed value to suppress alerts (Honesty Over Polish §10.3; FC-022)
counter_conditions: the recommended confidence floor produces too many false alarms or too few genuine alerts — request joint threshold re-tuning with operator feedback
an output field's operator-facing meaning is ambiguous — request the output-semantics documentation before building the visualization
